literal: In the proper way not striving effort, many people standing even if protected, flaw will incur.
translation: An effort that is not exerted using the proper method will fail, even if many people stand together to protect it.
modern: சரியான வழிமுறையில் முயற்சி செய்து தொடங்கப்படாத ஒரு செயல், பலரும் துணையாக நின்று காப்பாற்றினாலும் தோல்வியையே தழுவும்.
explanation: This couplet emphasizes the importance of using the correct method for any undertaking. If an action is not performed with the proper approach, it is fundamentally unsound and bound to fail. Even if many people gather to support and protect the endeavor, their collective strength cannot save it. The word 'பொத்து' meaning a hole or flaw vividly illustrates how a poorly planned project will inevitably leak and collapse.
